items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I think there was only one saxophone player around New Orleans then... His name was Mr. Ramos... Mr. Ramos played the tenor when I heard him.

ctx.x: Did they use the sax in the old days when your brother and you were coming up? No. When did they come in?

I think there was only one saxophone player around New Orleans then, and he played a double octave saxophone around New Orleans here. He was from Mexico. His name was Mr. Ramos. Oh. And he was about the only saxophone player. You mean double octave?
